content: 1. Ezogabine and fostemsavir both increase the QTc interval. Close monitoring is required. QTc prolongation has been reported with doses of fostemsavir exceeding the recommended levels. 2. Fexinidazole and fostemsavir both increase the QTc interval. Avoid coadministration or use alternative drugs. Fexinidazole should not be coadministered with drugs known to block potassium channels or prolong the QT interval. 3. Fostemsavir increases the levels or effects of fexofenadine by inhibiting OATP1B1/3 transporters. Therapy should be modified, and close monitoring is necessary. If possible, avoid coadministration or adjust the dose of OATP1B1/3 substrates when used with fostemsavir. 4. Fingolimod and fostemsavir both increase the QTc interval.
